app.guestNotice: You're browsing as a guest. <go>Sign up as a member</go> to like and collect artworks, or apply to become an artist and publish your own.

login.displayNameHint: The name others see. You can change it later.
login.guestHint: Look around as a guest first, and sign up when you want to like artworks or become an artist. You won't lose your account.

dashboard.guestTitle: Want to exhibit your own work?
dashboard.guestBody: Guests can only browse. Sign up as a member to upload artworks and submit them for review. This account will be kept.

grid.confirmDelete: Delete “{{title}}”? Its image files will be deleted too. This can't be undone.

allArtworks.title: All artworks
allArtworks.dragHint: Drag cards to reorder. The home page and the Floating Room show artworks in this order.

review.title: Pending review
review.author: Artist
review.reasonPlaceholder: Tell the uploader what needs to change

users.title: Users
users.passwordReset: Password reset for {{name}}. Let them know the new password.
users.confirmDelete_one: Delete {{name}}? Their {{count}} artwork and its images will be deleted too. This can't be undone.
users.confirmDelete_other: Delete {{name}}? Their {{count}} artworks and images will be deleted too. This can't be undone.
users.guestNote: Guest accounts aren't listed here. Guest accounts unused for 7 days are deleted automatically.

commission.title: Commissions
commission.openHint: Your profile shows an “Open for commissions” tag and a request button
commission.infoPlaceholder: What you take on, turnaround, revisions, usage rights…
commission.contactHint: Shown only while you're open for commissions

upload.fileType: Only JPEG, PNG and WebP images are accepted

editor.hotspotHint: Click the image to add a detail hotspot (up to {{max}}). Drag a number to move it.
editor.dropTitle: Drop an image here, or click to choose a file
editor.dropTypes: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {{size}} MB
editor.aiRequired: Please mark whether this artwork used AI
editor.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
editor.newNotice: Once you submit and an admin approves, it appears on the home page and in the gallery. You can also save a draft and keep editing.
editor.rejectedBanner: An admin returned this artwork: {{note}}. You can submit it again after making changes.
editor.pendingNotice: In review. Once an admin approves it, it appears on the home page and in the gallery.
editor.noHotspots: No hotspots yet. Click the image on the left to add one.

exhibition.title: Exhibition layout
exhibition.hint: Click a slot on the plan, then choose an artwork on the right. The Floating Room shows all published artworks automatically (in artwork order, up to {{max}}).
exhibition.noPublished: No published artworks yet. Drafts don't appear in the gallery.

applications.title: Artist applications
applications.reasonPlaceholder: Tell the applicant why it wasn't approved, or what else is needed

apply.title: Become an artist
apply.guestBody: Guests can only browse. Sign up as a member first, then apply to become an artist. This account will be kept.
apply.alreadyArtist: You're already an artist and can publish artworks.
apply.pending: Application sent. It's waiting for an admin to review, and you'll be notified of the result.
apply.rejectedBanner: Your last application wasn't approved: {{note}}. You can add more and apply again.
apply.intro: Artists can publish artworks and take commissions. Tell us a bit about your work, and it'll be enabled once an admin approves.
apply.messagePlaceholder: What you make, how long you've been creating, what you'd like to exhibit here…

profile.registerBody: Set a username and password to turn this guest account into a full membership. You can then like and collect artworks, and apply to become an artist.
profile.usernameHint: 3–24 lowercase letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens
profile.likesPublicHint: When off, only you can see your liked artworks on your profile
profile.commissionNote: Edit your commission info in <go>Commission settings</go>.
profile.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask an admin to reset it.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: No notifications yet. Likes on your artworks and review results will show up here.
notifications.approved: Your artwork {{title}} was approved and is now on display
notifications.artistApproved: Your artist application was approved. You can now publish artworks.
